text: {"question": "What is the minimum duration of inhaled corticosteroid (ICS) therapy required for studies to be eligible in this systematic review of children with asthma?", "answer": "Eligible studies in the systematic review needed to include children and adolescents with asthma who received inhaled corticosteroids for a minimum of 6 months.", "evidence": "Eligible studies included children and adolescents with asthma receiving ICS for at least 6 months."}
